$comment: The published error-code list of the Auth API (ADR 0001). Every code the API emits is listed here before it is emitted; a listed code is never renamed, removed or reused. 'pointer' (Validation codes only) is the RFC 6901 pointer of the request-body member the code concerns, or null when it concerns none or more than one. Transport and challenge codes are produced by the HTTP pipeline, not by handlers.
